annotations.title: Check AI-search readiness (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)

description: Checks whether AI assistants and AI search engines can find, read and cite the site: robots.txt rules for GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended, llms.txt, structured data (schema.org), server-rendered content, meta/canonical tags and sitemap. Returns a readiness score and prioritised fixes. Runs on the caller's own Apify account (APIFY_TOKEN) and is billed by Apify pay-per-event; nothing is charged by this server.

maxCostUsd.description: Spend cap for this run on YOUR Apify account (forwarded to Apify as maxTotalChargeUsd). Default from server config ($2).

maxPages.description: Pages to sample for content/structured-data checks.

url.description: Public website URL, e.g. "https://example.com" (https:// is added if missing). Private/internal addresses are rejected.

waitSecs.description: How long to wait for results before returning status "running" with a runId (the scan keeps going; use get_audit_results). Default 240.

name: check_ai_search_readiness

dryRun.description: true = sample data from the built-in mock, NOT a real scan

id.description: Stable identifier of the rule/check that produced the finding

impact.description: Business, legal or revenue impact in plain words

reportUrl.description: Full report (HTML/JSON) in the Apify key-value store

status.description: Apify run status: SUCCEEDED, RUNNING, FAILED, TIMED-OUT, ABORTED, or DRY-RUN

usageTotalUsd.description: Cost of the run on the caller's Apify account, when Apify reports it

status.description: "running" = the Actor is still working; call get_audit_results with run.runId later

title: Check AI-search readiness (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)
